summary: Find models, read routing advice and download public Ollama models.

help:
Usage: models [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Agent Hub model catalog, routing advice and managed local downloads

Options:
  --id <str>            Filter by model id or alias.
  --provider <str>      Filter by provider.
  --free                Only models marked free/free-tier.
  --coding              Only tool-capable coding candidates.
  --limit <int range>   [default: 50; 1<=x<=500]
  --json                Print filtered payload as JSON.
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  list   List canonical model catalog entries.
  route  Model, effort, Daybreak and context by job and tool; --task...
  pull   Download through an ephemeral registry; preserve the native...
help.list:
Usage: models list [OPTIONS]

  List canonical model catalog entries.

Options:
  --id <str>           Filter by model id or alias.
  --provider <str>     Filter by provider.
  --free               Only models marked free/free-tier.
  --coding             Only tool-capable coding candidates.
  --limit <int range>  [default: 50; 1<=x<=500]
  --json               Print filtered payload as JSON.
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.route:
Usage: models route [OPTIONS]

  Model, effort, Daybreak and context by job and tool; --task gives
  completion-route advice.

Options:
  --role <str>  Launch table: a work role or job (testing, lookup).
  --tool <str>  Launch table: claude-code, codex, pi, agent-hub or
                antigravity.
  --task <str>  Completion-route task type; omit to list task types.
  --json        Print the API response as JSON.
  --help        Show this message and exit.
help.pull:
Usage: models pull [OPTIONS] {model}

  Download through an ephemeral registry; preserve the native model manifest.

Arguments:
  model  Public Ollama [namespace/]name[:tag].  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

usage.when: inspect canonical Agent Hub model catalog without raw DB queries

usage.cmd: st models route [--role JOB --tool TOOL | --task TASK] [--json]
usage.when: which model, effort, Daybreak and context an agent gets for a job (--role, a work role or job such as testing or lookup) and tool; st aico create applies it by default. --task: completion-route advice; no options lists both
download a public model while the local Ollama daemon stays offline
precautions: Uses managed resource admission and a temporary loopback registry. Refuses to replace an existing different manifest; requires the official ollama CLI and a running local daemon.
